hate_speech.instructions: Does post.text attack, demean, or dehumanize people based on a protected trait (race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, etc.)?

criteria.true: Contains slurs, dehumanizing comparisons, or explicit calls for exclusion/harm directed at a protected group.
criteria.false: No attack on a protected group; criticism of ideas, institutions, or individual behavior without group-based dehumanization.

violence_threat.instructions: Does post.text threaten or incite physical violence against a specific person, group, or location?

criteria.true: States or strongly implies intent to harm, or calls on others to do so, against an identifiable target.
criteria.false: No credible threat; includes hyperbole, fiction, or discussion of violence without incitement.

sexual_content_minors.instructions: Does post.text or any post.media_urls depict, describe, or solicit sexual content involving a minor?

criteria.true: Any sexualized depiction, description, or solicitation involving someone who is or appears to be under 18.

self_harm_content.instructions: Does post.text promote, instruct, or encourage suicide or self-harm (as opposed to recovery discussion or seeking help)?

criteria.true: Provides methods/encouragement for self-harm or suicide, or glorifies it.
criteria.false: Neutral, supportive, or help-seeking discussion of self-harm/suicide; news reporting.

spam_or_scam.instructions: Is post.text unsolicited commercial spam, a phishing attempt, or a financial scam?

criteria.true: Unsolicited promotion, fake giveaways, credential/payment phishing, or deceptive financial schemes.
criteria.false: Genuine, on-topic content, including legitimate self-promotion in context.

violation_category.instructions: If post.text violates policy, which single category best describes the primary violation? Pick 'none' if it does not violate policy.

criteria.hate_speech: Attacks or dehumanizes based on a protected trait.
criteria.spam: Commercial spam, phishing, or scam content.

severity.instructions: Overall, how severe is this post's policy violation, considering both the content and its likely real-world harm?
